given.fr: Demande de couple 14 N·m ; codage entier non signé uint16, résolution 0,1 N·m/bit, offset zéro, little-endian. Le décodage inversé utilise aussi uint16.
given.en: Torque demand 14 N·m; unsigned uint16 integer, resolution 0.1 N·m/bit, zero offset, little-endian. Reversed decoding also uses uint16.

blocks.formula: raw = torque / resolution ; byte0 = raw mod 256 ; byte1 = floor(raw/256) ; wrong = (256 byte0 + byte1) × resolution

blocks.formula: Coverage = requirements with approved evidence / applicable requirements ; pass rate = passed / executed
